notes.subject: לארבעת פניו
notes.rationale: KJV/BSB 'its four faces' vs ASV/JPS 'for each of the four faces thereof' — ũgothi ũmwe wa mũndũ kana kwa mũndũ-wo-the; ndakĩhota kũgua rĩngĩ.

notes.subject: החיות
notes.rationale: 'indũrũ cia mĩoyo' (living creatures) — kiugo gĩa Kĩhibirania kĩugaga 'arĩa mĩoyo-mĩĩrũ', ti 'beasts' ya Kĩthwahĩri.

notes.subject: חיות ... חיות
notes.rationale: Kiugo kĩmwe kĩrarĩkio meerũ ĩrarĩkario, mũhianĩre wa Ezekieli ũrĩa wathĩnjĩte thĩinĩ wa kĩgeranio kĩa themanĩrĩru.

translation: Ndakĩona indũrũ cia mĩoyo, na rũcia! orĩngathi rĩmwe thĩ-inĩ wa thĩ, hakuhĩ nakĩo indũrũ cia mĩoyo, thĩinĩ wa ũgothi wa ngotho ĩnya ciao.
